units.source_text: 女人像避开似的，嘴里小声嘟囔着，听不清楚。

en.t: As if trying to avoid it, the woman muttered something under her breath, too softly to make out.

units.source_text: 可一见那情景，男人便理解了二三分。

en.t: But as soon as he saw what was happening, the man understood a little of it.

units.source_text: 不久，紧靠板壁的那一边，传来了小便的声音。

en.t: Before long, from the side right up against the plank wall, came the sound of urination.

units.source_text: 让人觉得那真是一种浪费。

en.t: It made one feel that it was truly a kind of waste.
